_readme: Machine-readable architecture map of the Timeline Estimator & PM tool, for the next agent. layers = diagram columns (left->right) with legend colors. nodes[] = the knowledge graph: {id,layer,label,sub,purpose,files[],tables?,notes?,flags?} — files are repo-relative path[:line]. edges[] = structural {from,to,label} dependency links (node ids). flows[] = ordered runtime paths, each step {n,from,to,action,files[]}. invariants[] = non-obvious rules to preserve when editing. permissionsMatrix mirrors Supabase RLS. Regenerate the HTML from this file (same object is inlined there).

meta.title: Timeline Estimator & PM Tool — Architecture & Flows
meta.subtitle: Every actor, route, store, Supabase table, trigger, realtime channel and external service — and the flows that connect them. Pick a flow to trace the path; click any node to see its files.
meta.stack: Next.js 16 (App Router) · React 19 · TypeScript · Zustand 5 (synced-store bridge) · Supabase (Auth · Postgres · RLS · Realtime · Storage) · Zoho CRM (OAuth2, read-only) · Tailwind 4 / shadcn
meta.mappedFrom: Static code analysis of app/, store/, hooks/, lib/, components/, supabase/migrations/ (29 migrations).
meta.modeSwitch: isSupabaseConfigured (lib/supabase/config.ts): NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_* present -> live Supabase (this map); absent -> Zustand + localStorage demo with DUMMY_* seeds.
droppedTables: discovery_projects (added 0010, dropped 0023 -> merged into proposals.discovery jsonb)

nodes.label: Admin
nodes.purpose: Full control: team mgmt, invites, offboarding, delete projects, estimator.

nodes.label: Manager
nodes.purpose: Create/edit projects & tasks, estimator, edit others' PTO/skills. No team mgmt, no project delete.

nodes.label: Member
nodes.purpose: Create/edit tasks, log own hours (accepted assignments only), own PTO/skills.

nodes.label: Viewer
nodes.purpose: Read-only across the app; action buttons hidden entirely, not just disabled.

nodes.label: Invitee
nodes.purpose: Invited; profile exists with confirmed_at=null; cannot be assigned work until accepted.
nodes.notes: Not an app role — a pending team-member state (store/team-store.ts:95). Invite is a single-use link; SafeLinks scanners can burn it.

nodes.purpose: Marketing splash + InviteHashCatcher (forwards Supabase implicit-flow hash to /accept-invite).

nodes.label: /login
nodes.purpose: Email/password sign-in; surfaces ?error=invite_invalid. Demo fakes success.

nodes.label: /register
nodes.purpose: Static invite-only notice — no self-signup.

nodes.label: /forgot-password
nodes.purpose: resetPasswordForEmail; always shows success (no account enumeration).

nodes.label: /auth/confirm
nodes.purpose: Verifies one-time email token on button click (SafeLinks-safe), then routes to ?next.

nodes.label: /accept-invite
nodes.purpose: Set password after invite/recovery session; updateUser({password}) -> /dashboard.

nodes.label: Dashboard shell

nodes.label: /projects

nodes.label: /projects/[id]

nodes.label: /…/sprints/[sid] · /backlog

nodes.label: /projects/[id]/activity
nodes.purpose: Project-scoped activity feed.

nodes.label: /activity
nodes.purpose: Workspace-wide activity feed with project/category/user/search filters.

nodes.label: /calendar
nodes.purpose: Month calendar: task due dates, sprint milestones, PTO.

nodes.label: /gantt
nodes.purpose: Read-only schedule/timeline; list fallback on mobile.

nodes.label: /workload
nodes.purpose: Estimated hrs vs weekly capacity (team) + WorkloadMine (personal).

nodes.label: /team
nodes.purpose: Members, inline role change, page-access dialog, skills, invites, deactivate/delete (admin only).

nodes.label: /settings
nodes.purpose: Tabs: Profile · Skills · Time off · Workspace(stub) · Security(stub).

nodes.label: /proposals
nodes.purpose: Quote list + create (guided or manual). Gated by canExportProposals.

nodes.label: /proposals/[id]
nodes.purpose: 5-tab estimator editor (Setup · Scope & risk · Line items · Adjust · Review) + export + Start project.

nodes.label: /reports
nodes.purpose: Workspace stats from live stores (team via team-store). In nav config (workspace group) so PageAccessGuard gates it like other pages.

nodes.label: /esther
nodes.purpose: Coming-soon card. EstherClient + esther-store exist but are NOT wired to this route.

nodes.label: projects-store
nodes.purpose: Projects CRUD; optimistic write-through + snapshot rollback; realtime board appliers.

nodes.label: sprints-store
nodes.purpose: Sprints CRUD ordered by position; optimistic + rollback; realtime.

nodes.label: tasks-store
nodes.purpose: Tasks + assignees + comments + reactions + time_entries; assignment lifecycle; logged hours; 7 realtime appliers.

nodes.label: team-store
nodes.purpose: Read-only profiles directory + invitee pending state; hydrated live from profiles.

nodes.label: notifications-store
nodes.purpose: Personal bell. notify() inserts one row per recipient (excludes actor); realtime filtered to recipient.

nodes.label: activity-store
nodes.purpose: Workspace feed. log() actor-prefixed, optimistic prepend; realtime streams whole workspace.

nodes.label: availability-store
nodes.purpose: PTO/availability CRUD; hydrate-only (no realtime).

nodes.label: weekly-capacity-store
nodes.purpose: Weekly hours/member; upsert onConflict profile_id.

nodes.label: member-skills-store
nodes.purpose: Skill confidence 1-5; upsert onConflict profile_id,skill; optimistic sort + rollback.

nodes.label: proposal-estimator-store
nodes.purpose: Quotes CRUD; regenerateLineItems; setProposalStatus; convertToProject. Line math: base×tier(1/1.5/2)×qty + compounding roll-up add-ons. Quotes imported from a CRM deal (or with a client picked from Accounts) carry `zoho` (0029): {deal_id?, account_id?, contact_id?, …, web_url}. previewConversion()/previewSchedule() compute the plan without writing; convertToProject/regenerateSchedule accept that reviewed preview and persist it verbatim.

nodes.label: discovery rules engine
nodes.purpose: analyzeDiscovery = computeEstimate (Min/Mid/Max per phase) -> computeTimeline (Gantt, 6h/day) -> computeRisk; proposalDraftFromDiscovery bridge. Derived on the fly, never stored.

nodes.label: proposal catalog
nodes.purpose: Per-platform catalog rows grouped by module; findMissingDependencies. Source: project-csv xlsx.

nodes.label: auth-store
nodes.purpose: Session mirror: role, authId, page_access. authId gates every live write. Demo default role = manager.

nodes.label: task UI + timer stores
nodes.purpose: useTasksStore (selectedTaskId/activeView) + useTaskTimerStore (per-task timers -> appendLoggedHours). Not persisted.

nodes.label: nav-drawer-store
nodes.purpose: Mobile drawer open state. Not persisted.

nodes.label: esther-store
nodes.purpose: Local AI-chat messages. Exists but not wired to a live route.

nodes.label: usePermissions
nodes.purpose: Role -> 10 capability flags. UX mirror of RLS — NOT authoritative; keep in lockstep with 0002_rls.sql.

nodes.label: useAuth
nodes.purpose: Only hook calling Supabase Auth directly: signIn / signUp / signOut. Exposes isConfigured.

nodes.label: useNavAccess
nodes.purpose: role + page_access -> allowed nav hrefs (ALWAYS_ON: /dashboard, /settings).

nodes.label: useTimeTrackingAccess
nodes.purpose: Accepted-assignee / admin gate for logging time.

nodes.label: WorkspaceSync
nodes.purpose: On auth, hydrates all synced stores + opens 3 realtime channels. Gated on isSupabaseConfigured && authId; no-op in demo.

nodes.label: AuthProvider
nodes.purpose: Reads profiles, onAuthStateChange -> applyProfile / resetToDemo. Produces the authId everything gates on.

nodes.label: PageAccessGuard
nodes.purpose: Redirects to /dashboard if current path isn't in the user's accessible href set.

nodes.label: isSupabaseConfigured
nodes.purpose: THE demo/live switch: both NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_* present. Branch point in every store & WorkspaceSync.

nodes.label: supabase browser client
nodes.purpose: createBrowserClient (anon key), fresh per call. Transport for every synced store + auth pages.

nodes.label: supabase server client
nodes.purpose: createServerClient bound to next/headers cookies. Used by require-admin() to authenticate + role-check the admin API routes.

nodes.label: supabase admin client
nodes.purpose: Service-role, server-only, RLS-bypass; null without SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.

nodes.label: requireAdmin()
nodes.purpose: Auth + role=admin gate for API routes; returns ctx {supabase,admin,user} or ready 401/403/501.

nodes.label: updateSession
nodes.purpose: Session-cookie refresh + route guards (unauth->/login, authed off /login). No-op without env.

nodes.label: proxy.ts (root)
nodes.purpose: Next 16 renamed middleware -> updateSession on every matched request (matcher skips static assets).

nodes.label: parseSupabaseError
nodes.purpose: Maps auth/RLS/network errors to friendly strings for toasts (incl. invite-only trigger mask).

nodes.label: POST /api/invites
nodes.purpose: Admin-only: upsert allowed_emails + inviteUserByEmail; self-heals SafeLinks-burned invites (delete unconfirmed + resend).

nodes.label: POST /api/users/[id]/status
nodes.purpose: Admin-only: ban/unban + set/clear profiles.deactivated_at. Guards self + last active admin.

nodes.label: DELETE /api/users/[id]
nodes.purpose: Admin-only permanent deleteUser (must be pre-deactivated, not last admin). DB anonymizes via set-null FKs.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth (GoTrue)
nodes.purpose: Password / invite email / recovery / sessions. JWT in httpOnly cookies via @supabase/ssr. Also the email sender.

nodes.label: RLS + current_user_role()
nodes.purpose: Row-Level Security on all 15 tables — the authoritative authorization wall. usePermissions only mirrors it.

nodes.label: handle_new_user
nodes.purpose: Invite-allowlist gate + profile create (invited role, page_access, confirmed_at). Rejects un-invited emails.

nodes.label: handle_user_confirmed
nodes.purpose: On email_confirmed_at flip: set profiles.confirmed_at, delete allowlist row.

nodes.label: prevent_role_self_change
nodes.purpose: Blocks non-admin self-change of role / page_access / deactivated_at (skips NULL-role system writes).

nodes.label: prevent_unauthorized_hours
nodes.purpose: Only accepted assignee / admin may change tasks.logged_hours.

nodes.label: profiles
nodes.purpose: User dir: role, avatar_url, page_access[], deactivated_at, confirmed_at. PK -> auth.users(id) cascade.

nodes.label: projects
nodes.purpose: owner_id -> profiles (set null @0020). status active/completed/archived.

nodes.label: sprints
nodes.purpose: project_id -> projects (cascade). status, start/end, position.

nodes.label: tasks
nodes.purpose: project_id -> projects; sprint_id -> sprints (null=backlog); reporter_id -> profiles. logged_hours (trigger-guarded).

nodes.label: task_assignees
nodes.purpose: PK(task_id,profile_id). status pending/accepted/rejected/passed, assigned_by, responded_at, note.

nodes.label: task_comments
nodes.purpose: author_id -> profiles (set null @0020); parent_id self; mentions uuid[].

nodes.label: comment_reactions
nodes.purpose: PK(comment_id,profile_id,emoji).

nodes.label: availability_entries
nodes.purpose: user_id -> profiles. start/end, kind, note.

nodes.label: weekly_capacity
nodes.purpose: PK profile_id. hours_per_week check 1-168.

nodes.label: notifications
nodes.purpose: recipient_id, actor_id, project_id, text, href, read. Realtime + RLS recipient-only.

nodes.label: activity
nodes.purpose: actor_id, project_id, text, href. Realtime whole workspace; read = all authenticated.

nodes.label: proposals
nodes.purpose: owner_id, project_id, platform, line_items jsonb, addons jsonb, discovery jsonb, status draft/sent/approved/rejected. `zoho` jsonb (0029) links the quote back to its Zoho Deal / Account / Contact.

nodes.label: time_entries
nodes.purpose: task_id, profile_id, hours>0. Insert RLS: own AND accepted assignment. tasks.logged_hours is the cache.

nodes.label: member_skills
nodes.purpose: PK(profile_id,skill). confidence 1-5. Write = self OR admin/manager.

nodes.label: allowed_emails
nodes.purpose: PK email. role, invited_by, page_access. Admin-only. Consumed + retired by handle_new_user / handle_user_confirmed.

nodes.label: channel notifications:{authId}
nodes.purpose: postgres_changes filtered recipient_id=eq.authId -> notifications-store (insert/update/delete).

nodes.label: channel activity:workspace
nodes.purpose: activity INSERT for the whole team -> activity-store.

nodes.label: channel workspace:board
nodes.purpose: projects/sprints/tasks/assignees/comments/reactions changes -> respective stores. Idempotent appliers dedupe own echoes.

nodes.label: Storage: avatars bucket
nodes.purpose: Public bucket, 5MB, image mime; path <uid>/<file>. ProfileForm upload -> profiles.avatar_url.

nodes.label: Supabase email (GoTrue SMTP)
nodes.purpose: Sends invite + recovery emails. No Postmark/Resend/SendGrid/SMTP lib anywhere — built-in only.

nodes.label: jsPDF + jspdf-autotable
nodes.purpose: Client-side PDF export of a quote (dynamic import).

nodes.label: xlsx (SheetJS)
nodes.purpose: Client-side Excel export of a quote (dynamic import). Only file importing xlsx.

nodes.label: DOMPurify
nodes.purpose: Sanitizes mention HTML (span-only, class attr) before render.

nodes.label: sonner
nodes.purpose: Toasts for every store's error/success + one-shot Undo path.

nodes.label: next-themes
nodes.purpose: Light/dark theme.

nodes.label: i.pravatar.cc
nodes.purpose: Demo-only avatar seeds; not used in live mode.

nodes.label: assignment engine
nodes.purpose: planSchedule(tasks, devs, platform, {strategy, phaseStart}) -> per-task assignee + capacity-aware dates + finishDate. NOT AI. skillTiers() maps a task to required skills (platform skill for dev work; keyword rules for plugin/DNS/domain/go-live; Quality Assurance for QA); specialists win, generalists are a fallback tier. Strategies: quick (spread across qualified devs, earliest finish) vs efficient (highest-skilled, fewer hands). buildRoster() assembles devs from team + skills + weekly_capacity/5 + PTO. Self-check: lib/assignment/plan.check.ts (48 asserts).

nodes.label: zoho token store
nodes.purpose: getAccessToken() returns a cached access token, refreshing ~1min before expiry via the stored refresh_token; zohoFetch(path) calls the CRM against the connection's api_domain with `Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken`. Uses an untyped service-role client so it can read zoho_connection (RLS has no policies).

nodes.label: requireZohoReader()
nodes.purpose: Gate for CRM reads. Leads carry PII (names, phones, emails), so this is limited to admin + manager — the same tier as canExportProposals. Members/viewers get 403.

nodes.label: GET /api/zoho/connect · /callback
nodes.purpose: connect: admin-only; sets an httpOnly SameSite=Lax `zoho_oauth_state` CSRF cookie and redirects to Zoho consent with access_type=offline&prompt=consent (guarantees a refresh_token). callback: verifies state, swaps the code for tokens on the DC-specific `accounts-server`, stores the singleton row, then redirects to /settings?zoho=<outcome> (connected | notstarted | statemissing | badstate | denied | exchangefailed | norefresh | savefailed).

nodes.label: GET /api/zoho/status · /org · POST /disconnect
nodes.purpose: status: reports {configured, connected, connectedAt, apiDomain} — never tokens. org: proof-of-connection, fetches /crm/v2/org. disconnect: deletes the stored connection.

nodes.label: zoho_connection
nodes.purpose: Workspace-wide Zoho OAuth tokens (refresh_token, access_token, api_domain, accounts_server, expires_at, connected_by). RLS ENABLED WITH NO POLICIES by design — unreachable by anon/authenticated; only the service-role key (server routes) can touch it.

nodes.label: Zoho CRM
nodes.purpose: OAuth at {accounts_server}/oauth/v2/token; REST at {api_domain}/crm/v2. Granted scopes (live) are READ-only: ZohoCRM.modules.READ, users.READ, org.READ, settings.READ. Org: Strategic Connection (~122k Leads, ~923 Deals). Phase 3 write scopes (deals.CREATE/UPDATE + attachments.CREATE, verified against Zoho's own docs, no DELETE/ALL) are STAGED in .env.local/.env.example only — inert until a Vercel env update + Disconnect→Connect re-consent by someone with Zoho CRM edit rights.

nodes.label: GET /api/zoho/deals
nodes.purpose: Lists CRM Deals for the Estimator's import picker, by stage (`criteria=(Stage:equals:…)`) or free text (`word=`), else most-recently-modified. Builds a deep link per deal from the org id (cached per instance) since Zoho returns no record URL. Real deals often have Amount=0 and Service_Interested_in=null, so those are surfaced as optional.

nodes.label: GET /api/zoho/accounts
nodes.purpose: Three things: `?q=` searches Accounts (companies, ~4.0k) and — when nothing matches — falls back to searching Contacts and returns THEIR companies tagged `viaContact`; `?contactsOf=<id>` lists a company's people via /crm/v2/Accounts/{id}/Contacts; and every company list is enriched with that company's prior Deals via ONE batched `Account_Name:in:<ids>` query (verified: 25 ids in a single ~540ms call — per-account lookups would have been 25 calls). Deal enrichment is best-effort: a failure returns no deals rather than breaking the company list. Replaced the Leads lookup: Accounts/Contacts are the qualified records, Leads (~122k) are raw and noisy.

nodes.label: POST /api/zoho/deals/[id]/push
nodes.purpose: The app's only CRM writes, both explicit buttons. Quote editor -> Deal "Proposal Sent" + proposal PDF; project page (once status=completed) -> Deal "Project Completed", no attachment. Target stage is WHITELISTED in lib/zoho/push-state.ts so a crafted request can't set Closed Won/Lost — revenue stages stay sales' call. Writes ONLY Stage (Amount is a Zoho formula field, Quote_number a system autonumber; both verified unsettable). Idempotent PER STAGE via proposals.zoho.pushes (stage -> timestamp), checked+written server-side because Zoho does not dedupe attachments. Stage move is fatal-on-failure; the attachment is best-effort and warns.

flows.name: Sign in (live) + session guard
flows.summary: Password login -> httpOnly-cookie session -> profile mirrored to auth-store -> WorkspaceSync hydrates. proxy.ts refreshes the cookie on every request.

steps.action: signInWithPassword -> JWT stored in httpOnly cookies
authId set -> hydrate all stores + open realtime
every request: updateSession rotates cookie; blocks /login when authed

flows.name: Invite -> onboard
flows.summary: Admin invites -> allowlist row + GoTrue email -> invitee confirms (OTP on click) -> handle_new_user creates the pending profile -> set password.

steps.action: clicks link; verifyOtp fires on button click (SafeLinks-safe)
email confirmed -> set confirmed_at, delete allowlist row

flows.name: Forgot / reset password
flows.summary: Recovery email -> implicit-flow hash caught on landing -> set new password.

steps.action: clicks link; InviteHashCatcher catches type=recovery hash

flows.name: Create project -> sprint -> task
flows.summary: Optimistic write-through at each level; realtime board channel echoes to every member.

steps.action: insert; rollback + toast on RLS error
createTask (reporter_id pinned to auth.uid by RLS)
realtime echoes the new task to every member's board

flows.name: Task assignment: accept / reject / pass
flows.summary: Assignee responds on the task drawer; server pins assigned_by; realtime syncs the board.

steps.action: accept=update status; reject=delete row; pass=delete self + insert peer pending

flows.name: Log time -> workload
flows.summary: Only an accepted assignee (or admin) can log hours — enforced by RLS AND a trigger. Feeds personal + team workload.

steps.action: insert only if own AND accepted assignment — managers can't log
WorkloadMine (personal) / WorkloadClient (team) read hours vs capacity

flows.name: Notifications + activity (realtime)
flows.summary: A domain event fans out to the workspace feed + per-recipient bell; realtime pushes both back to clients.

steps.action: insert one row/recipient with actor_id (no self optimistic add)

flows.name: Estimator — guided scope -> approve -> start project
flows.summary: Questionnaire -> rules engine (Min/Mid/Max + timeline + risk) -> generate line items -> approve -> convertToProject seeds a real backlog.

steps.action: Generate line items -> regenerateLineItems -> proposalDraftFromDiscovery (mid hrs, tier basic, add-ons OFF)
seed backlog tasks from line_items (estimated_hours=li.hours, tags=[phase])

flows.name: Estimator — catalog -> quote -> export
flows.summary: Import catalog rows (or freehand) -> compounding roll-up add-ons -> PDF/Excel export.

steps.action: line math: base×tier(1/1.5/2)×qty; roll-up add-ons compound responsive->design->qa->pm

flows.name: PTO / availability + capacity
flows.summary: PTO entries + weekly capacity feed the calendar and workload views. Editing others needs canEditOthersAvailability.

steps.action: calendar shows PTO alongside due dates + milestones

flows.name: Member skills (star ratings)
flows.summary: 1-5 confidence per skill; decoupled from role. Write = self OR admin/manager.

steps.action: upsert onConflict profile_id,skill; optimistic sort + rollback

flows.name: Offboard user (deactivate -> hard delete)
flows.summary: Two-tier: deactivate (reversible ban + flag) then optional permanent delete (anonymizes owned rows).

steps.action: set deactivated_at (guards: not self, not last active admin)
cascade delete; owner/reporter/author FKs -> NULL 'Former member'

flows.name: Avatar upload (Storage)
flows.summary: Upload to the public avatars bucket (owner-folder policy), then persist the public URL.

steps.action: upload to avatars bucket (path <uid>/<file>, 5MB / image mime)

flows.name: Approved quote -> scheduled project (auto-assign)
flows.summary: Start project opens a two-step dialog: options -> reviewed schedule preview -> confirm. Only on confirm does it turn the estimate's tentative timeline into real sprints, seed line items as tasks, and assign each dev/QA task from skills + capacity + PTO. The project's timeline IS its sprints.

steps.action: Approve quote -> Start project (Best-fit / Fastest / Manual)
buildRoster(): confirmed+active members with >=1 skill; hours/day = weekly/5; PTO excluded

previewConversion() -> SchedulePreview (sprints, per-task assignee + dates). WRITES NOTHING; user reviews it, then Confirm passes it back so the persisted plan is EXACTLY what was shown (never recomputed).
insert one sprint per estimate phase — AWAITED before tasks (FK)
insert tasks with sprint_id + due_date from the plan
insert task_assignees status=pending (dev accepts / rejects / passes)
Timeline section renders the project-scoped Gantt; manager adjusts sprint dates + assignees

flows.name: Zoho CRM — connect (OAuth2)
flows.summary: One admin connects once; the refresh token is stored server-side workspace-wide and every later CRM call reuses it. No end user ever sees a Zoho screen.

steps.action: GET /api/zoho/connect — requireAdmin, set httpOnly state cookie (10 min)
upsert singleton row (service role; RLS has no policies)

flows.name: Zoho deal -> pre-filled estimate
flows.summary: The CRM's 'Proposal Requested' stage means a client wants a quote. Import that deal to start an estimate pre-filled with its client and dates, linked back to the CRM record.

steps.action: Estimator -> 'Import from Zoho' -> pick a stage (Proposal Requested / Discovery / Negotiation / Verbal Yes) or search
Deal_Name, Stage, Account_Name{}, Contact_Name{}, Owner{}, Closing_Date, Quote_number
createProposal({title, client_name, zoho:{deal_id,…}}) — scope/hours are still built by hand
router.push -> editor shows 'Imported from Zoho CRM' + View in Zoho link

flows.name: Pick a client from Zoho (Accounts -> Contacts)
flows.summary: Two-step client picker over the qualified CRM records: find the company (with its prior-deal history shown inline), then the person (a company can have several). Replaced the Leads lookup.

steps.action: "Find in Zoho" on the Client field — from EITHER the New-estimate dialog (s-proposals) or the editor Setup tab (s-propeditor)
Accounts/search?word=; if 0 -> Contacts/search?word= and surface their companies 'via <person>'
enrich: ONE batched Deals/search?criteria=((Account_Name:in:<all ids>)) -> prior deals per company (best-effort; failure = no deals shown)
updateProposal({client_name, zoho:{account_id, contact_id, …}}) — 'company only' is allowed

flows.name: Push to Zoho — proposal sent, then project completed
flows.summary: The two points where the app writes to the CRM, closing the workflow diagram end to end. Both explicit; each stage can only be pushed once.

steps.action: Click "Push to Zoho" (shown only when quote.zoho.deal_id exists, disabled once pushed)
buildProposalPdfBlob() — jsPDF is browser-only, so the PDF is built client-side and POSTed as multipart
read proposals.zoho — if pushed_at set, stop (idempotency guard, server-side so a double-click cannot race)
PUT /Deals/{id} {Stage:"Proposal Sent"} — fatal if it fails
POST /Deals/{id}/Attachments (multipart; zohoFetch skips its JSON Content-Type so the boundary survives) — best-effort, warns on failure
write pushed_at + pushed_stage so the button disables and a retry cannot duplicate the attachment

Later: project marked completed -> "Mark complete in Zoho" -> Deal moves to "Project Completed" (no attachment). Allowed even though "Proposal Sent" was already pushed, because the guard is per-stage.

invariants: RLS is the authoritative authorization wall (0002_rls.sql +); usePermissions() is a UX mirror only — keep the two in lockstep.

isSupabaseConfigured is the single demo/live switch. No env -> Zustand + localStorage demo with DUMMY_* seeds. Live -> stores start empty + loading, hydrate via WorkspaceSync; localStorage persists EMPTY (partialize) so Supabase stays the source of truth.
Live writes are optimistic write-through + structuredClone snapshot rollback; demo writes use a one-shot Undo toast (not a stack).
Live IDs are crypto.randomUUID() generated client-side up front — no temp->real swap.

Realtime publishes only 8 tables: notifications, activity, projects, sprints, tasks, task_assignees, task_comments, comment_reactions. proposals / time_entries / member_skills / availability_entries / weekly_capacity / profiles / allowed_emails hydrate on load only.
Guided estimates ship with add-ons OFF (phases already itemize design/QA/PM) to avoid double counting; risk / timeline / Min-Mid-Max are derived by analyzeDiscovery on the fly, never stored.
Line math: base_hours × tier (basic 1 / advanced 1.5 / custom 2) × qty. Roll-up add-ons compound: responsive -> design -> qa -> pm. requirements_unclear forces every line to Advanced.
Time logging is server-enforced: only an accepted assignee (or admin) can log hours (time_entries insert RLS + tasks_guard_hours trigger). Managers/coordinators cannot log hours.

Invites are single-use GET links; email SafeLinks scanners can burn them, so /auth/confirm verifies the OTP only on button click and /api/invites self-heals a burned invite (delete unconfirmed + resend).
Privileged ops (invite, ban/unban, hard-delete) never run in the browser — only via 3 service-role API routes behind requireAdmin().
Hard delete anonymizes: owner/reporter/author FKs are ON DELETE SET NULL ('Former member', 0020). Deactivate is a reversible ban + deactivated_at flag.

page_access is a per-user href allowlist, orthogonal to role, guarded against self-grant (0027). PageAccessGuard only gates paths present in dashboard-nav-config (gateableNavItems) — a route missing from that list is reachable by any authenticated user.
Next 16: the root middleware file is proxy.ts (renamed from middleware.ts).
TanStack Query is installed but NOT wired (no QueryClientProvider) — the synced-store bridge covers caching. There is no lib/api and no axios; supabase-js replaces that layer.
Esther (AI chat): store + EstherClient exist but the /esther route is coming-soon / unwired.
Email is Supabase built-in GoTrue only — no Postmark/Resend/SendGrid/SMTP dependency anywhere.

A project's timeline IS its sprints — there is no separate timeline table. convertToProject scaffolds one sprint per estimate phase and slots each seeded task in (join key: phaseLabelForLineItem <-> PHASE_META[id].label; unmatched -> backlog). GanttClient renders it, and `lockedProjectId` embeds it on the project page.

convertToProject / regenerateSchedule must insert sprints BEFORE tasks (task.sprint_id FK) AND optimistically upsert both into the stores — a realtime echo is not guaranteed to arrive before the user navigates. Skipping the optimistic upsert caused the 'converted project looks empty' bug.

The assignment engine never assigns a task to a dev lacking the matched skill. skillTiers() returns tiers best-first and the FIRST tier with an eligible dev wins, so specialists beat generalists. Phases with no dev-skill mapping (design/discovery/content/SEO) stay unassigned but still reserve time. Only confirmed+active profiles WITH skills are eligible — an unseeded workspace assigns everything to the one skilled user.

zoho_connection (0028) has RLS ENABLED WITH NO POLICIES on purpose: only the service-role key may read/write it. Verified — anon SELECT returns 0 rows, INSERT 401, UPDATE/DELETE report 204 but match 0 rows. Zoho tokens must never reach the browser; /api/zoho/status returns metadata only.

Zoho scopes are frozen into the token at consent time (currently READ-only: modules/users/org/settings). Widening them requires editing ZOHO_SCOPES, redeploying, AND a Disconnect -> Connect re-consent — an existing refresh token cannot gain scope.

Zoho API quirks that cost time: search `criteria` supports only equals/starts_with (`contains` -> 400 INVALID_QUERY), so single-box search uses `word=` (Accounts, Contacts and Deals all); record counts need v2.1+ (`/actions/count` 400s on v2); the callback must use the `accounts-server` query param, not a hardcoded DC; bulk read needs a separate ZohoCRM.bulk.READ scope.

proposals.zoho (0029) is written through TWO whitelists — `quoteUpdatePayload()` and the `Pick<ClientQuote,…>` param type of `updateProposal`. Miss either and the edit updates the store but silently never persists. Same trap applies to any future column on proposals.

CRM client data comes from Accounts (companies, ~4.0k) + Contacts (people, ~3.7k), NOT Leads (~122k raw/unqualified, full of test+spam rows). A Lead converts into Account+Contact(+Deal); the qualified records are the ones worth showing. An account can have many contacts, so the picker is two-step.

Zoho write-back writes ONLY Deal.Stage. Amount is a formula field and Quote_number a system autonumber on this org — both accept a write, report SUCCESS, then keep/restore their computed value. Never re-add them to the push payload without re-testing against a real Deal.

Zoho does NOT dedupe attachments — the same filename uploaded twice creates two records. The guard is proposals.zoho.pushes (stage -> timestamp), checked and written SERVER-side; it is per-stage so a deal can advance more than once, but no single stage can be pushed twice. Read it via zohoPushes(), which folds in the legacy pushed_at/pushed_stage fields.

Zoho stages the app may set are whitelisted in lib/zoho/push-state.ts (Proposal Sent, Project Completed). Closed Won / Closed Lost are deliberately excluded: "approved" here means the team agreed to start work, not that a client signed, so revenue stages stay a human sales decision.
